notes: Stories created for multi-cluster routing governance with clear separation of contract, logic, integration, and testing.

change_log.value: Added schema and routing contract definition story

change_log.note: Ensures real usage in data layer

stories.title: Define Multi-Cluster Routing Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define configuration schema for multiple MongoDB clusters including cluster roles (primary, secondary, analytics), routing rules, environment prefixes, and failover policies. Establish a contract for how services request a cluster (by capability or dataset type).

stories.title: Implement Cluster Routing and Selection Logic
stories.description: Build core logic that determines which MongoDB cluster to route to based on request context (read/write, dataset type, environment). Include deterministic routing rules and fallback handling if a cluster is unavailable.

stories.title: Integrate Routing Logic with Mongo Utilities
stories.description: Integrate the routing engine into shared MongoDB utilities so that all database access flows through the routing layer. Ensure compatibility with existing connection lifecycle management and context manager patterns.

stories.title: Expose Routing Configuration and Health Signals
stories.description: Provide internal API or config access to expose active cluster routing decisions, cluster health status, and current mappings for debugging and observability. No external UI required.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Multi-Cluster Routing
stories.description: Create tests validating correct cluster selection for different request types, environment routing, and failover behavior. Include integration tests simulating dual-cluster scenarios.

per_feature.mitigation: Default to primary cluster and log all routing decisions for traceability
